environment: **Generated, not source**: `example/` is a golden fixture produced wholesale by `./scripts/refresh-example.sh`. Never infer project tooling or conventions from it, and never hand-edit it — change the overlay and regenerate. Its `justfile` and `docs/Makefile` targets (`up`, `down`, `apidocs`, `livehtml`) belong to the generated Django app and are not how this repository is worked on.

**Project toolchain**: `uv` only, per CONTRIBUTING.md — `uv sync --extra wizard`, `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run pre-commit`, `./scripts/refresh-example.sh`. There is no Makefile or justfile at the repository root.

**Publishing is out of bounds**: releases go through `.github/workflows/release.yml` on a `v*` tag, using PyPI Trusted Publishing. A local `uv publish` or `twine upload` bypasses the reviewed release path, and PyPI does not allow re-uploading a version — it cannot be undone.
hard_deny: Uploading a distribution to PyPI or any package index (`uv publish`, `twine upload`, `python -m twine`). Irreversible: a released version can never be replaced. Releases are published by CI from a tag.
Pushing a `v*` tag. That tag is the release trigger, so pushing it publishes to PyPI.
soft_deny: Rewriting the golden `example/` by hand instead of running `./scripts/refresh-example.sh`. Hand edits are silently discarded on the next regeneration.
